vb_textbox.text: My main point of advice in order to do well at this game is to simply PAY ATTENTION and stay alert.  1.5 seconds is certainly enough time to choose, but if your attention lapses & you miss a round this can cost you points (in my experience).  The rewarded amount of points seems to have little bearing on which gnome you choose each round. However, I found it helpful to try consistently selecting a particular shaped gnome (i.e. more rounded or more pointed) until I received a low score, at which point I would alternate my preference.  I did not notice a significant outcome pattern, although this methodology did indeed help me to concentrate on the task. So to clarify - simply concentrate on the task and try not to miss any rounds. This is probably the best advice I can offer to maximise the amount of points you can get.
